sentences.text: This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.142/2024 registered at Police Station - Naigarhi, District- Mauganj (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 498A and 306/34 of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 19.04.2024.
2 .
As per prosecution story, the deceased committed suicide by consuming poison herself.
After completion of investigation, FIR was registered against the applicant and his family members.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
The ingredients of Section 306 and 107 of IPC are not made out in the present case.
There is no previous criminal antecedents of the applicant.
Charge sheet has been filed.
He is in custody since 19.04.2024.
The co-accused Phoolmati and Umesh have been enlarged on bail.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail on the ground of parity.
2 MCRC-18117-2024 3. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
4. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

5. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
